title: JEEBench record (pipeline evaluation)
description: One problem of JEEBench, frozen for the pipeline's evaluation (thesis Objectives 3-4).
x-format: JSON Lines: one JSON object per line, each matching this schema
x-note: Documentation only: no code reads this schema.

id.description: Problem id: 'jee-' + subject + '-' + the dataset's index.

type.description: Question type as given by JEEBench.

exam.description: The exam paper the problem comes from.

kind.description: Answer kind: choice = one correct option, multi = one or more correct options, value = an integer or numeric answer.

key.description: Gold answer: the option letter(s) in lower case (for example 'b' or 'abd'), or the number.

examples.subject: math
examples.question: What is the total number of distinct $x \in[0,1]$ for which $\int_{0}^{x} \frac{t^{2}}{1+t^{4}} d t=2 x-1$?
